Lemma H.15.

Let G∼G⁡(n,p)G\sim G(n,p), where p∈(0,12]p\in(0,\frac{1}{2}], be a random graph. And we assume p≫((ln⁡n)/n)1/(2​mH−2)p\gg((\ln n)/n)^{1/(2m_{H}-2)} unless HH is an edge. Let ℳ\mathcal{M} be a (1,δ)(1,\delta)-DP mechanism that answers all range subgraph counting queries up to additive error α\alpha with probability β\beta. Then α≥Ω⁡(discCσ,γ​(𝐀H))\alpha\geq\Omega(\mathrm{disc}_{C_{\sigma,\gamma}}(\mathbf{A}_{H})), where γ=p,σ=Ω⁡(1−9​δβ)\gamma=p,\sigma=\Omega(1-\frac{9\delta}{\beta}).

Proof Sketch.

We choose ε=1\varepsilon=1 and ε′=ε+10\varepsilon^{\prime}=\varepsilon+10. By Lemma H.13, this implies δ′=2​δ⋅1+e−ε−101−e−10≤3​δ\delta^{\prime}=2\delta\cdot\frac{1+e^{-\varepsilon-10}}{1-e^{-10}}\leq 3\delta, then with probability 1−δ′1-\delta^{\prime} over i∈[n]i\in[n] and 𝐱←X∣Y=𝐲\mathbf{x}\leftarrow X_{\mid Y=\mathbf{y}}, we have

2−ε′​1−pp≤Pr𝐱←X∣Y=𝐲[𝐱i=0∣𝐱−i]Pr𝐱←X∣Y=𝐲[𝐱i=1∣𝐱−i]≤2ε′​1−pp.\displaystyle 2^{-\varepsilon^{\prime}}\frac{1-p}{p}\leq\frac{\Pr_{\mathbf{x}\leftarrow X_{\mid Y=\mathbf{y}}}[\mathbf{x}_{i}=0\mid\mathbf{x}_{-i}]}{\Pr_{\mathbf{x}\leftarrow X_{\mid Y=\mathbf{y}}}[\mathbf{x}_{i}=1\mid\mathbf{x}_{-i}]}\leq 2^{\varepsilon^{\prime}}\frac{1-p}{p}. (17)

Then we can prove the lemma by contradiction. That is, we assume that ℳ\mathcal{M} has an additive error smaller than 12​discCσ,γ​(𝐀H)\frac{1}{2}\mathrm{disc}_{C_{\sigma,\gamma}}(\mathbf{A}_{H}) with probability at least β\beta. Then we can show that for each possible output 𝐲\mathbf{y} of the mechanism ℳ\mathcal{M}, with probability greater than δ′\delta^{\prime}, Equation 17 is violated. To do so, we only need to show that 1) with high probability, 𝐱\mathbf{x} is good in the sense that it satisfies the desired properties; and 2) conditioned on the event that 𝐱\mathbf{x} is good, the inequality (17) is violated with probability greater than δ′\delta^{\prime}, if we set γ=p\gamma=p and σ=2−ε′−3⋅(1−3​δ′β)\sigma=2^{-\varepsilon^{\prime}-3}\cdot(1-\frac{3\delta^{\prime}}{\beta}), which leads to a contradiction.

Part 2) follows from the same argument as those in the proof of Lemma 5.3 in (26). For part 1), we describe our changes. Note that the probability that 𝐱∼X∣Y=𝐲\mathbf{x}\sim X_{\mid Y=\mathbf{y}} is good is at least (1−poly⁡(1/n))⋅β(1-\mathrm{poly}(1/n))\cdot\beta by Lemma H.11. This then finishes the proof of the lemma. ∎

Finally, we finish the proof of the lower bound for d≥n/2d\geq n/2.

Theorem H.16.

Let ℳ\mathcal{M} be an (ε,δ)(\varepsilon,\delta)-DP mechanism and G∼G⁡(n,p)G\sim G(n,p), where p∈(0,12]p\in(0,\frac{1}{2}]. And we assume p≫((ln⁡n)/n)1/(2​mH−2)p\gg((\ln n)/n)^{1/(2m_{H}-2)} unless HH is an edge. If ℳ\mathcal{M} answers all dd-dimensional (d≥n/2d\geq n/2) range subgraph counting queries about GG up to an additive error α\alpha with probability at least β\beta, then α=Ω⁡(m​(1−c)⋅LSfH​(G))\alpha=\Omega(\sqrt{m}(1-c)\cdot\mathrm{LS}_{f_{H}}(G)), where c=e−1eε−1​·​9​δβc=\frac{e-1}{e^{\varepsilon}-1}\textperiodcentered\frac{9\delta}{\beta}.

Proof.

Note that m=Θ⁡(γ​n2)m=\Theta(\gamma n^{2}). Then Θ⁡(n​γ)=Θ⁡(m)\Theta(n\sqrt{\gamma})=\Theta(\sqrt{m}). Lemma H.15 together with Lemma H.10 imply that there is no (1,δ)(1,\delta)-DP mechanism ℳ\mathcal{M} whose error with probability at least β\beta is below o⁡(m​(1−9​δβ)⋅LSfH​(G))o(\sqrt{m}(1-\frac{9\delta}{\beta})\cdot\mathrm{LS}_{f_{H}}(G)).

Let us assume for contradiction, that there is an (ε,δ)(\varepsilon,\delta)-DP mechanism ℳ⁡(𝐱)\mathcal{M}(\mathbf{x}) whose error is smaller than o⁡(m​(1−c)⋅LSfH​(G))o(\sqrt{m}(1-c)\cdot\mathrm{LS}_{f_{H}}(G)) with probability β\beta, where c=e−1eε−1⋅9​δβc=\frac{e-1}{e^{\varepsilon}-1}\cdot\frac{9\delta}{\beta}. Note that fH​(𝐱ε)=ε−mH​fH​(𝐱)f_{H}(\frac{\mathbf{x}}{\varepsilon})=\varepsilon^{-m_{H}}f_{H}(\mathbf{x}). Let us consider a mechanism εmH​ℳ​(𝐱ε)\varepsilon^{m_{H}}\mathcal{M}(\frac{\mathbf{x}}{\varepsilon}). By Lemma H.14, it is (1,e−1eε−1​δ)(1,\frac{e-1}{e^{\varepsilon}-1}\delta)-DP. Moreover, it has error

εmH⋅o⁡(mεmH​(1−c)⋅LSfH​(G))≤o⁡(m​(1−c)⋅LSfH​(G))\varepsilon^{m_{H}}\cdot o\left(\frac{\sqrt{m}}{\varepsilon^{m_{H}}}(1-c)\cdot\mathrm{LS}_{f_{H}}(G)\right)\leq o\left(\sqrt{m}(1-c)\cdot\mathrm{LS}_{f_{H}}(G)\right)

with probability at least β\beta — a contradiction. ∎

When the parameters p,ε,δp,\varepsilon,\delta in Theorem H.16 are constants, we show that any (ε,δ)(\varepsilon,\delta)-DP algorithm incurs an additive error of Ω⁡(n​GSfH)\Omega(n\mathrm{GS}_{f_{H}}) by Lemma H.11.
